description: Lava Komodo default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/lava_komodo-character-sheet.webp: the six palette chips (intake.json swatches magma orange 254,115,58 / magma yellow 255,190,69 / dark stone 67,58,57 / rock 148,84,69 / red rock 163,72,57 / accent 167,145,125) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL, median of a box per surface; boxes in each note). GLOW (drawn on the sheet): the magma cracks, the molten chest panel (orange outer band, a hotter V, a yellow core) / jaw / tail underside, the melting lower body, the drips, the lava pool, the eyes and the flame crest; tiers lava < crack < drip < pool < molten < molten_mid < molten_core < eye < crest_outer < crest_inner; peak emission (max channel / 255 x emission_scale x material emission_strength) stays under the 2.0 cap.
